title: Close the lease, hold and strict-session fail-opens and repair the two comments sfg-4 falsified
action: The sfg-4 judge returned NEEDS_REVISION: the same store-data fail-open is still live on two paths, and sfg-4 itself falsified two comments and left one silent lockout. Four jobs, all in hooks/write_guard/ plus hook_local.rs. (1) LEASE AND HOLD READERS. check_write reaches date_parse_ms through checks.rs:466 find_session_conflicts -> store.rs:836 list_active_reservations -> store.rs:823 lease_record_expired -> store.rs:811, and again at store.rs:824 lease_to_reservation (expires_at AND acquired_at, store.rs:774-775), checks.rs:500 find_foreign_holds -> store.rs:932 (mirrored_at), checks.rs:484 hold_expiry -> store.rs:960-962, checks.rs:518/530 foreign_hold_expiry -> store.rs:969, checks.rs:637 find_conflicts, and paths.rs:452 inside resolve_live_worker_count. list_path_lease_records (store.rs:723-751) validates no timestamp at all, so one lease carrying "expires_at": "tomorrow" turns the whole guard off. Make every one of these readers infallible by signature, exactly as sfg-3 and sfg-4 did, and pick the RESTRICTIVE read at each site: a lease or hold whose expiry cannot be parsed is NOT expired, so it still conflicts and still denies. (2) THE STRICT-SESSION ESCAPE. main.rs:427 is_shared_nested_checkout_target? sits on the hook's own R<..> path and runs for every Edit/Write with a resolvable target (shared_candidates is pushed on both branches, main.rs:397-405), so one truncated .bee/sessions/<id>.json makes store.rs:346 return Err and the guard falls open on a real write. The recorded decision for this cell: a guard NEVER falls open on data it merely read, and Node-parity wording is not worth a hole — so close it with a DENY in bee's own clear wording, naming the unreadable session file and its remedy. Say in the comment that this deliberately departs from the Node V8-worded crash log. (3) TWO FALSE COMMENTS sfg-4 left. hook_local.rs:763-767 and hook_local.rs:836-841 still assert that an unparseable heartbeat reads as false and fails OPEN so an unreadable session store never turns a permitted solo write into a refusal. After sfg-4 it reads as a LIVE peer and does exactly that. Correct both to state what the code now does and why the restrictive read is right there. (4) THE SILENT LOCKOUT. An unparseable last_heartbeat now reads live forever with no self-heal, so a bad owner record can lock every other session out of a checkout with no visible reason. Do not reopen the door: keep the restrictive read, and emit a stderr warning naming the unreadable session file and the remedy, so a human sees WHY they are refused instead of guessing. Prove red-first throughout: a test per fixed reader that the guard still DECIDES on malformed data, plus a test that the strict-session path DENIES rather than falling open, each failing before the fix.

truths: A lease or hold record carrying a malformed, numeric or missing timestamp NEVER makes the write guard report undecidable, on any of the enumerated paths.
An unparseable lease or hold expiry reads as NOT expired, so it still conflicts and still denies — the restrictive read at every site.
A truncated or unreadable session file on the strict path makes the guard DENY, naming the file and the remedy — it never falls open on an Edit, a Write or a Bash command.
The departure from Node-parity wording on that deny is stated in the code with its reason.
The two hook_local.rs comments state what the code actually does with an unparseable heartbeat; no comment in the module asserts a fail-open the code no longer performs.
An unparseable last_heartbeat that locks other sessions out emits a warning naming the file and the remedy — the lockout is never silent.
Every truth sfg-1, sfg-3 and sfg-4 proved still holds; all seventeen sfg1_*/sfg3_*/sfg4_* tests still pass untouched.

acceptance: No malformed session, claim, cell, lane, lease, hold or config record can switch the write guard off on any path; the strict-session path denies instead of falling open; no comment contradicts the code; the write_guard suite is green.

checks.evidence: All eight are infallible by signature and no caller ?s them: store.rs:869 lease_to_reservation -> Resv, store.rs:923 lease_record_expired -> bool, store.rs:936 list_active_reservations -> Vec<Resv>, store.rs:948 find_conflicts -> Vec<Resv>, store.rs:963 find_session_conflicts -> Vec<Resv>, store.rs:1025 find_foreign_holds -> Vec<Map>, store.rs:1097 hold_expiry -> String, store.rs:1114 foreign_hold_expiry -> String; the ? is gone at checks.rs:471/489/507/525/537/644 and paths.rs:428/452, and a module-wide scan shows zero remaining ? on date_parse_ms or ms_to_iso.

Every site takes the not-expired arm: store.rs:926-929, store.rs:1059-1062, store.rs:876-880 (display-only ttl), store.rs:1102-1108 and 1119-1125 fall to UNREADABLE_EXPIRY rather than no-expiry; no site releases a conflict. HUNT (follow-up, not a FAIL): a lease with an unparseable expires_at never expires, so it holds its path forever and keeps counting toward resolve_live_worker_count (paths.rs:452-460); the cross-session deny at checks.rs:482-490 still says Wait for the hold to expire, which is now false, and names no lease file — the heartbeat lockout got a warning, the identical lease/hold lockout did not.

store.rs:416-427 list_session_records_strict -> Result<_, PathBuf> turns read_session_strict's Err(Nd) into the file path; hook_local.rs:1140-1143 maps it to SharedNested::UnreadableSession; main.rs:445-449 turns that into unreadable_session_refusal. read_session_strict has exactly one caller, so no Nd survives. Pinned by sfg5_an_unreadable_session_file_denies_instead_of_falling_open (tests.rs:2829). Bash reachability is structural (main.rs:287-292 pushes shared_candidates on the Bash branch, and the deny loop at main.rs:426 sits outside the split) but no test exercises the Bash surface for this deny.

Re-enumerated module-wide. Cleared: read_json_g never Errs, so read_state/read_session/plan_freeze_shape_approved/session_workspace_id/active_worker_session_ids/claim readers are Err-free; read_config is Ok(read_config_raw); control_root_for_state is infallible; read_session_strict is contained; no ? remains on date_parse_ms/ms_to_iso. SURVIVING ESCAPE: hook_local.rs:1015 serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|_| Nd)? (and :1013 for a non-ENOENT read error) in resolve_verified_companion_mount_real — a present-but-CORRUPT .bee/companion-session.json — propagates through hook_local.rs:1044 -> hook_local.rs:1149 target_inside_verified_companion_mount? -> main.rs:438 ? -> Outcome::Delegate -> emit_undecidable -> exit 0. Preconditions are the ones sfg-5 just closed one line above: a resolvable Edit/Write target plus one other live session. tests.rs:3284-3286 holds only because that fixture has no live peer.

hook_local.rs:763-781 and 848-860, store.rs:463-502, store.rs:332-348, store.rs:851-868/1015-1024/1090-1096 and checks.rs:466-470/505-506 all check out. mod.rs:40-41 does not: this commit narrowed the shared-nested bullet to non-ENOENT fs errors while walking the target's ancestry, which now omits the corrupt companion-session.json JSON-parse delegate at hook_local.rs:1015; mod.rs:24-27's CORRUPT JSON IS NATIVE also does not hold for that marker, which is read with bare std::fs::read plus serde_json::from_str rather than read_json_g.

store.rs:479-489 calls warn_unreadable_heartbeat (store.rs:492-508), naming the session file, the last_heartbeat cause and bee state session release, via queue_guard_warning_once (jspath.rs:523-530) onto the same thread_local read_json_g uses, so a Delegate emits zero bytes by the mechanism tests.rs:3432 already pins. Pinned by sfg5_an_unparseable_heartbeat_lockout_is_never_silent (tests.rs:2860). HUNT (clean): main.rs:49 clears the queue once per evaluation, so the dedupe cannot leak across evaluations and its size is bounded by the number of bad files on disk.

Exactly 8 sfg1_* + 5 sfg3_* + 4 sfg4_* = 17 prior tests remain (tests.rs:2107-2609) plus the 6 new sfg5_*; the diff's only two test deletions are outside those tests (an arity change at tests.rs:1616 and a helper at tests.rs:3893). cargo test --release sfg printed 23 passed, 0 failed.

Each new test fails without the production change: the three lease tests assert code 2 where the pre-change ? on lease_record_expired/lease_to_reservation yielded Nd -> Delegate -> exit 0; the hold test likewise via checks.rs:507 and additionally asserts the new expiry-unknown string where pre-change was no-expiry; the unreadable-session test asserts exit 2 where Err(Nd) delegated at exit 0; the lockout test asserts the warning names the file where the pre-change heartbeat_stale had a bare Err(_) => false and no warning.

semantic_judge.failure_signature: A corrupt .bee/companion-session.json still switches the whole write guard off: hook_local.rs:1015 map_err(|_| Nd)? -> hook_local.rs:1149 -> main.rs:438 -> emit_undecidable -> exit 0, on any Edit/Write with a resolvable target once one other session is live — the same class and the same function sfg-5 closed at hook_local.rs:1140 — and mod.rs:40-41's rewritten delegated-branch bullet now excludes it.
